metadata.title: Scalar curvature growth on nonnegatively curved three-manifolds
metadata.abstract: Let $(M^3,g)$ be complete, connected, noncompact, and without boundary, with nonnegative sectional curvature. We give a level-set argument for an asymptotic upper bound on the scalar-curvature integral. In the one-ended case the argument yields \[ \limsup_{r\to\infty}\frac1r\int_{B_p(r)}\operatorname{Scal}\,d V \le 8\pi\bigl(1-{V_M}\bigr). \] No pole, noncollapsing condition, or scalar-curvature bound is assumed. The proof uses an almost convex smooth exhaustion together with a separate smooth approximation to the distance function. The negative curvature errors of the level sets are integrable. In the two-ended case the splitting theorem gives an actual limit bounded by $16\pi$. The one-ended bound is attained for every prescribed asymptotic volume ratio in $[0,1]$; the two-ended constant is also attained. The one-ended conclusion is an upper-limit bound; existence of the corresponding limit is not asserted.

analysis.progressType: 三维标量曲率积分增长
analysis.workSummary: 用水平集法证明非负截面曲率开三流形单端情形的归一标量积分 limsup 上界，并对双端情形以分裂获得实际极限界。
analysis.breakthrough: 无需极点、非塌缩或标量曲率界即可得到尖锐上界。
analysis.limitations: 单端结论仅断言 limsup，未断言极限存在；单端与双端常数须区分。
analysis.priorityReason: 无需极点、非塌缩或标量曲率界即可得到尖锐上界。
